description: Finds named organisations by payee-name substring in the MORVS Judgment Fund Register. Returns up to 50 matches by published amount, with total match count, summed bi-weekly payment-line amount, line count, agency groups, Treasury citation descriptions, and first and last report periods. Only payees confirmed as organisations appear; individuals are never named. A payment is not an admission of fault, a line is not a settlement, and the separate annual and bi-weekly Treasury products must never be added.

payee.description: Required case-insensitive substring of a named payee. Individuals are never named.

name: judgment_fund_payee
title: Find Named Judgment Fund Payees
